craft_notes: Sthāyin: void-fire oblation (the inner homa: mind offers all, awareness is the ladle). Rows: row 2 (offered→ladle). Close: ladle (sruc-word — awareness as spoon: the image-word closes, end-weighted). Rejected: 'sacrifice everything' moralized — killed: oblation all kept (sarvahavis as the offered-total); 'consciousness' abstract — killed: awareness-ladle kept (the ladle makes it an instrument, not a state).

lines: Great void-abode, in fire: sense-objects and such:
offered by mind, oblation all, awareness-ladle.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mahāśūnyālaye vahnau bhūtākṣaviṣayādikam | hūyate manasā sārdhaṃ sa homaś cetanāsrucā

reads_against.argmap: What is offered in the great void? → In the void-fire, mind offers all with the awareness-ladle.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra with śānta (resolve closing the practice arc)
